title: Regression: Unwanted Interruption Prompts During Conversation Flow
body:
**Bug Description**
After upgrading to **v0.2.120** I'm noticing a degradation where Claude will stop and ask me every second prompt "Would you like me to propose a fix for this?" or "Would you like me to ....?" even when I'm prompting as I always do - I've specifically added an instruction to CLAUDE.md to never confirm a fix or an implementation unless I explicitly ask it to check with me during a brainstorming session. I've had to downgrade again.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.104 (after downgrading)
- Feedback ID: 02dc7fd5-0371-497e-a2ee-5eb305847c2b
author: guidedways
